Once more, a horde of Yo-kai descends upon Eorzea! Join in the fun and get your paws on weapons, mounts, a framer's kit, and minions─including Jibanyan and Whisper! This time around, the event features three new indoor furnishings: wibbly-wobbly Jibanyan, wibbly-wobbly Komasan, and wibbly-wobbly USApyon. * This event is identical to the one previously held, with the addition of three indoor furnishing items. * If you have already completed the quest for this event, it cannot be accepted again. However, you may still earn Yo-kai Medals while equipped with a Yo-kai Watch. * During the event, Yo-kai Watches will be available for purchase from recompense officers in major cities.

Event Duration

From Tuesday, August 4, 2026 at 1:00 a.m. (PDT) / 8:00 (GMT) / 9:00 (BST) / 18:00 (AEST) to Monday, October 5, 2026 at 7:59 a.m. (PDT) / 14:59 (GMT) / 15:59 (BST) / Tuesday, 6 October at 1:59 (AEDT) * Dates and times are subject to change.

How to Participate

Speak with the poor-heeled youth on the Steps of Nald (X:9.2 Y:9.1) in Ul'dah. Upon completion of the quest, you will receive a Yo-kai Watch and Yo-kai Medallium which you can use to obtain Yo-kai Medals. * Players must be level 15 and above to start the quest. * Players must have completed one of the following main scenario quests: "The Gridanian Envoy," "The Lominsan Envoy," or "The Ul’dahn Envoy." Final Fantasy 14: How to Unlock Occult Crescent North Horn
items.summary: Read ahead for how to unlock Occult Crescent North Horn in Final Fantasy 14 along with all rewards.
items.content:
By Stephanie Watel Published Jul 28, 2026, 7:20 PM EDT Stephanie Watel is a Contributing Writer at DualShockers who has been covering games professionally since 2022. She specializes in guides and reviews, with additional experience writing lists and features across RPGs, horror games, cozy sims, action games, open-world RPGs, JRPGs, and indie titles.

Before joining DualShockers, Stephanie contributed to GameRant , IGN , MovieWeb , Pro Game Guides , Twinfinite , and Prima Games . Her work has covered major releases, underground sleeper hits, and indie games across a wide range of genres. Stephanie holds a B.A. in English , including studies in journalism.

Generate a summary of this story Jump links Jump Links How to Unlock Occult Crescent: North Horn How to Travel to Occult Crescent: North Horn Occult Crescent: North Horn Rewards Like Like follow Follow followed Followed Thread Log in Here is a fact-based summary of the story contents: Try something different: Show me the facts Explain it like I’m 5 Give me a lighthearted recap The Patch 7.55 update in Final Fantasy 14 brings with it a variety of new content for players to dive into, as the Dawntrail expansion truly begins to wind down and the buzz around Evercold continues to (ironically) heat up. Along with updates to Phantom Weapons, the Solution 9 leg of the ever-going Hildibrand questline, and the finale of the Allied Society questline, the Occult Crescent has finally gotten its next major region for players to explore.

If you're eager to make your return to the Occult Crescent, here's how to unlock the North Horn region, including all quests involved, as well as some of the valuable rewards you can earn during your adventures in the area.

The time has come to discover the franchise of the crystals.

The second major region of the Occult Crescent Field Operations content, North Horn, was added as part of the game's Patch 7.55 update. Before anything else, note that you'll need to have unlocked the South Horn region first, and completed its storyline up through the ' Mysteries Abide ' blue quest.

Once that's situated, make your way to Tuliyollal and speak to the Expedition Messenger at (X :17.2, Y:11.8 ) to pick up the 'Occult Reunion' quest . You must have a Level 100 combat class (Disciple of War or Magic) equipped to do so. Follow the objectives of the quest to the Phantom Village, and speak to the blue-garbed Roegadyn named Ketenramm near the fountain at ( X:6.1, Y:6.5 ).

Next, speak to Jeffroy, the Expedition Coordinator up the stairs to the north at (X:4.5, Y:6.5) to finish the quest and officially unlock the North Horn as an accessible area.

To travel to the North Horn area of the Occult Crescent, simply speak to Jeffroy, the Expedition Coordinator at ( X:4.5, Y:6.5 ) in the Phantom Village, and a list of available options will pop up for him. Select the 'North Horn' option near the top, and you'll then be placed into a queue for an instance of the region.

Once there, you can get yourself familiarized with the base camp and the NPCs there who can help you with various things. You'll also find Ketenramm, Archive, and Iris to continue the North Horn's storyline.

Other important NPCs to make note of here include the Expedition Supplier ( X:39.0, Y:38.6 ) who offers basic supplies for sale and can repair your gear, along with the Expedition Trader nearby to the right, who can exchange extra Soul Shards you have on hand.

Meanwhile, the Expedition Antiquarian nearby to the right ( X:39.5, Y:38.7 ) sells a diverse variety of rewards in exchange for Silver and Gold Obol tokens. You can pick up sets of ilvl 780 gear with inherent buffs specifically for the Occult Crescent, along with other rewards such as glamour sets, minions, furnishings, Soul Shards for unlocking more Phantom Jobs, Orchestion Rolls, and more.

The Expedition Antiquarian at the Base Camp in the North Horn is your main hub for reward exchanges. As you earn Gold and Silver Obol tokens from your adventures in the region, you can exchange them with her for a variety of valuable rewards, some of which you can keep or turn around and sell on the Market Board for substantial gil.

While some of the rewards are more miscellaneous in nature (e.g. — Materia), there are certain ones you'll want to make note of.

items.title: New Final Fantasy 14 release brings an end to Dawntrail's relic quest and more
items.summary: Dancing Mad (Ultimate) just got a little easier
items.content:
By Willa Rowe Published Jul 28, 2026, 12:18 PM EDT News Congrats on beating Dancing Mad (Ultimate), it was easier before patch 7.55

FFXIV Evercold will finally modernize some of the MMO's most outdated features Final Fantasy 14 fans think they know what Evercold's big mystery is Future Final Fantasy remakes would take even more games says Naoki Yoshida New Final Fantasy 14 release brings an end to Dawntrail's relic quest and more Image: Square Enix Final Fantasy 14 Sign in to your Polygon.com account It's new patch day for Final Fantasy 14 . Patch 7.55 brings a number of changes and additions to Square Enix's MMO as it winds down the Dawntrail expansion and prepares for next year's Evercold . The latest patch marks the end of a number of long-running quest series and tweaks one of game's most difficult encounters.

Warriors of Light will be thrilled that 7.55 brings the conclusion of the Phantom Weapons relic quest line. That means all of Dawntrail' s relic weapons can be upgraded to their final tier, with Square Enix also reducing the cost to enhance any subsequent Phantom Weapons after players obtain their first. Completing the Phantom Weapons quest will involve exploring the newly added North Horn within Occult Crescent, Dawntrail 's massive field operation. The full patch notes include an extensive rundown of everything added to Occult Crescent's complex gameplay systems, including the introduction of Blue and Black Mages as phantom jobs.

Patch 7.55 also marks the end of the Inconceivably Further Hildibrand Adventures. The Hildibrand quests continue to be some of the funniest storylines in Final Fantasy 14 , and Dawntrail has been no different. While it will be sad to say goodbye to Hildibrand for now, Square Enix is sure to bring him back for more fun in Evercold . Another set of content concluding in patch 7.55 is the allied society quests.

Players who have continued to struggle with Dancing Mad (Ultimate) will find yet another slight update to the challenging raid in patch 7.55. Visibility for Celestriad, an ability Kefka uses in the fifth and final phase of the fight, was improved by enlarging elemental icons used for the mechanic. Last month Square Enix pushed a hotfix last month that fixed an annoying segment involving panels that sent players in different directions. So congratulations on clearing Dancing Mad (Ultimate) after this patch, even if people will say it was harder before.

Finally, patch 7.55 adds a number of cosmetic items including a new hairstyle, mounts, emotes, and several furnishings. The standout, however, is the latest chocobo barding, which adorns your trusty steed in a picnic-ready outfit complete with a large bonnet. For a complete rundown of everything patch 7.55 brings, check out the Lodestone blog. Final Fantasy 14 's next patch, 7.56, will be released in September and begin setting the stage for Evercold .

items.title: Final Fantasy 14 Will Be The Nintendo Switch 2's Biggest Game by Install Size
items.summary: Square Enix MMO Final Fantasy 14 will land on Switch 2 with an almighty thud next month, as its honking install size will take up almost half of the console's 256GB memory.
items.content:
Square Enix MMO Final Fantasy 14 will land on Switch 2 with an almighty thud next month, as its honking install size will take up almost half of the console's 256GB memory.

Final Fantasy 14 will weigh in at 117.2GB when it launches for Switch 2 on August 4, an eShop listing for the title has now revealed. Here's hoping you have space for it — or the budget to buy a new SD card.

That's around double the game's install size on PlayStation 5, which benefits from some clever file compression technology, though similar to the game's memory footprint on PC. It's a hefty download, though perhaps to be expected when you consider the MMO's size and the amount of content that has been added over the years.

The upside to all this is that the filesize includes all of the game's previous five expansions — Heavensward, Stormblood, Shadowbringers, Endwalker and Dawntrail — so you won't need more space to play any of those. The downside? A sixth expansion, Evercold, is already on the way — meaning you'll likely need even more memory space from next January.

Somewhat amusingly, Final Fantasy publisher Square Enix is no stranger to holding the record for the biggest Switch 2 games by memory size. Until the launch of Final Fantasy 14, Square Enix's Final Fantasy 7 Rebirth holds the current record (91.8GB) for a single game, as well as the record for a game bundle (the Kingdom Hearts Collection, which includes a trio of titles that weigh in at 131GB total).

Final Fantasy 14 game director Naoki Yoshida suited up in Bastion armor to take the stage at Final Fantasy 14 Fan Festival 2026 in Berlin to confirm the title's long-awaited Switch 2 launch date over the weekend, alongside a laundry list of new updates coming in the near future . The game's first month on sale will be offered without any subscription charge as its servers are stabilized. After this period comes to an end, players will be required to purchase a subscription as normal.

items.summary: Square Enix announced Final Fantasy XIV will launch for the Nintendo Switch 2 on August 4 and the Evercold expansion [...]
items.content:
Square Enix announced Final Fantasy XIV will launch for the Nintendo Switch 2 on August 4 and the Evercold expansion will launch in January 2027.

Pre-orders for the Switch 2 versions are now open. It will require a separate monthly subscription from the other version, however, it will not require a Nintendo Switch Online subscription. Users subscribed to other platforms can get a 50 percent discount on the subscription price on the Switch 2.

View the Evercold expansion extended trailer below:

Square Enix today revealed brand-new information about Evercold , the sixth expansion for its critically acclaimed MMORPG Final Fantasy XIV Online , set to launch in January 2027 alongside new playable content, a Final Fantasy VII Remake trilogy crossover raid series, the Nintendo Switch 2 version release date, and more.

An extended teaser trailer for Evercold was also revealed, providing a glimpse into the world of the Fourth and the adventures that await the Warrior of Light in the start of the Goddless Realms Saga story arc.

During the Fan Festival 2026 in Berlin keynote address, Producer and Director Naoki Yoshida revealed the first new job coming to Evercold : Bastion—a main tank that wields a pair of greatshields known as skyltborg—and unveiled a trailer showcasing the new job in action.

Details were also shared on several new features coming to Evercold , including changes to the narrative structure that will be implemented for the main scenario, field, and game system, allowing players more freedom to choose what area they complete first between various paths in the main scenario. Through Auto Content Balancing, difficulty scaling and enemy levels will adjust to the appropriate player level as they play through dungeons in their chosen order. Additionally, a first look was provided for Character Action Skins, a feature that lets players assign alternate animations to personalize existing General actions, such as Teleport and Warp, with support for additional skins such as job actions arriving in future updates. Character customization will also be expanded so players have more ways to make their character stand out, including a greater range of color options with the new color picker, the ability to fine-tune features such as eyes and lips, new elements such as eye shadow, and more.

Following the reveal of the Evangelion “Ghosts of Desire” alliance raid series in April, Yoshida unveiled a new teaser trailer and announced that acclaimed director and animator Mahiro Maeda will join the project as a special guest artist and designer. Throughout his career, Maeda has contributed to numerous acclaimed projects, including Mad Max: Fury Road (2015) as a concept artist and designer, and Evangelion:3.0 +1.0 Thrice Upon a Time (2021), where he served as director, concept art director, storyboard artist, art setting designer and key animator.

Joined on stage by Final Fantasy VII Remake series Director Naoki Hamaguchi, Yoshida also revealed “Beyond the Lifestream,” a new Final Fantasy VII -themed eight-player raid series that players will challenge in Evercold . Both development teams are working closely together to create an exciting new raid experience for players.

Further, Final Fantasy XIV will launch on Nintendo Switch 2 on Tuesday, August 4, 2026, with pre-orders starting today on Nintendo eShop. To ensure server stability, there will be an approximately one-month free subscription period on Nintendo Switch 2. Whether beginning with the Free Trial, starting their adventure with the Starter Edition, or diving into the full story and experience with the Complete Edition, more players than ever before will soon be able to join together in the vast world of Final Fantasy XIV .

An outline of the content reveals from the keynote address can be found below:

Finally, Yoshida revealed the Evercold Collector’s Bundle, which includes a collection of physical items: the Evercold Special Art Box, Expertly Crafted Reaper Figure, Ethos Metal Keychain, Köttr Mini Plush, and Tapestry of the Fourth. Also included is the digital Collector’s Edition, featuring three in-game items: the Crystal Skyltborg bastion weapon, Vallhallar Odin mount, and Entreat Crystal emote. More information regarding availability and pre-orders will be announced in the future.

items.title: Play Free for up to 4 Days in the Latest Free Login Campaign!

items.content:
In the hope that would-be adventurers can experience all that FFXIV has to offer, we are pleased to announce the latest Free Login Campaign. Follow the Trail to the Heavens! In Patch 7.5, you can face Enuo in the Unmaking, take a stroll through Windurst: The Third Walk in the FINAL FANTASY XI alliance raid crossover, and leap into battle in Archeia Harmonias, an all-new arena for Crystalline Conflict. A host of other additions and adjustments will make your time in Eorzea more streamlined and enjoyable, including increased furnishing placement limits, the consolidation of dyes, and additional pieces of gear that can now be converted to outfit glamour or stored in the armoire. With the introduction of Patch 7.5, the Shadowbringers expansion can now be played as part of the FINAL FANTASY XIV Starter Edition. The expansion will be automatically registered to your account if you already own the Starter Edition, so why not take this opportunity to jump into the adventure?

If you or any of your friends are currently taking a break from your adventures, you won't want to miss out on this limited-time event! Visit the Free Login Campaign website for details.
